answer.summary: E2E job failed because the OpenAEV API never came up: Spring context hit an UnsatisfiedDependency error and the health check returned HTTP 000 for 300s. The PR bumps the eclipse-temurin base image in the Dockerfile, so a deterministic startup failure from that change is the likely cause. Migrations ran fine and no test assertion failed. Confidence is moderate because the log is truncated and never names the missing bean.
